title.en: Aquatic browsing and giant terrestrial browsing comparison
title.zh: 水栖取食与巨型陆栖取食比较

description.en: A reproducible entry point for comparing two richly described lineages without treating the interface as a phylogenetic result.
description.zh: 用于比较两个具有丰富档案的谱系的可复现入口；界面本身不构成系统发育结论。

limitations: Comparison fields inherit each claim, range and occurrence source boundary; visible differences are not tests of evolutionary causation.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Perissodactyla time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的奇蹄类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Perissodactyla interval in the diversity view to inspect bundled sample counts, not an estimate of total richness.
description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的奇蹄类区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.

title.zh: PETM 北方大陆样本窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 56 Ma PETM anchor to inspect the earliest sampled perissodactyl context across North America, Europe and Asia, including the named European jaws IRSNB M 167 and BMNH M36494 used in the 71-terminal study.
description.zh: 在约 5600 万年前的 PETM 锚点打开地图，检查北美、欧洲和亚洲最早采样奇蹄类的背景，包括 71 个末端研究使用的欧洲具名下颌标本 IRSNB M 167 与 BMNH M36494。

limitations: The 56 Ma value is a rounded PETM evidence anchor; the named jaws and other craniodental observations are specimen-level evidence, while their placements and rapid-dispersal interpretation come from a morphology matrix.

The study leaves the order's origin and ghost lineages unresolved. This sampled northern-landmass window is not a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestor, or exact specimen-to-map-marker co-location.

title.zh: 北美三趾马族辐射窗口

description.en: Open the 17–8.5 Ma review-matrix interval around 14 Ma to inspect the North American hipparionin radiation, including the named Cormohipparion and “Merychippus” records that frame persistent tridactyly.
description.zh: 在约 1400 万年前、覆盖 17–8.5 Ma 综述矩阵区间的地图窗口中，检查北美三趾马族辐射，包括界定持续三趾形态的 Cormohipparion 与 “Merychippus” 具名记录。

limitations: This is a North American review-matrix envelope, not a single locality or a complete Hipparionini range. The approximately 14 Ma selector is a rounded interval context, and gait, diet and digit-reduction explanations remain comparative hypotheses.
Regional sampling and taxonomy are uneven; the window does not establish a global FAD/LAD, a direct ancestor, complete distribution, or exact fossil-to-map-marker co-location.

title.en: Late Old World hipparionin records window
title.zh: 旧世界晚期三趾马族记录窗口

description.en: Open the selected 1–0.6 Ma terminal regional window to inspect the Chinese Proboscidipparion and African Eurygnathohippus records retained in the Old World review.
description.zh: 打开精选的 1–0.6 Ma 区域末期窗口，检查旧世界综述保留的中国 Proboscidipparion 与非洲 Eurygnathohippus 记录。

limitations: The window combines selected Chinese and African regional records, with ages rounded from the cited review; it is not one continuous lineage or a global last-appearance survey.

Named regional records, inferred dispersal history and ecology remain distinct evidence types. Sampled markers do not establish a global LAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, or exact fossil-to-map-marker co-location.

title.zh: 披毛犀属西藏最早记录窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 5.08 Ma earliest-known Coelodonta anchor from the Zanda Basin review to inspect the Tibetan Plateau context for C. thibetana before the later East Asian and northern-Eurasian records.
description.zh: 打开综述所指约 508 万年前札达盆地披毛犀属最早记录锚点，检查东亚及北欧亚较晚记录之前 C. thibetana 的青藏高原背景。

limitations: The 5.08 Ma value is the reviewed earliest-known genus record and a rounded navigation anchor, not a directly observed global FAD or a molecular crown age. Species-level ecology and the proposed Tibetan-to-northern-Eurasian history remain study-bounded.

This locality window does not turn a regional record into a complete distribution, direct ancestor, or exact fossil-to-map-marker co-location; later Coelodonta species and the 14.4 ka individual remain separate evidence anchors.
